shared_elements: schematic arms or hands on the torso
incised/low-relief linear signs on the body
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces treat an upright monolithic form as a schematic human-like body, with body markings, arm/hand indications, circular motifs, and a horizontal waist or belt zone. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by multiple animal and sign-like reliefs arranged in bands on an otherwise faceless pillar, while B presents a more explicit frontal human figure with head, shoulders, chest discs, and torso features.
